# Mohammad Ali Jesar (mjesar)

> Senior full-stack and AI engineer (Ruby on Rails) in Lahore, Pakistan with 7+ years of experience. Shopify and e-commerce apps, integrations, MCP servers, RAG with pgvector and AI agents. Open to remote roles and freelance work. Uses the handle mjesar on GitHub, LinkedIn and Fiverr.

Identity: Ruby on Rails engineer based in Lahore, Pakistan, who builds Shopify and BigCommerce apps and adds AI (MCP servers, RAG, agents) to Rails applications. Holds a B.S. in Information Technology from Sindh Agricultural University and previously worked as a backend engineer at SimpleDeploy. Online handle: mjesar. Available now for remote roles and freelance work. Based in Lahore, Pakistan (UTC+5) with flexible hours: adapts to the client's time zone, including U.S. and European business hours.
